C45121.observed:
What was checked: that a job line's status prints as ordinary text rather than the coloured pill you see on screen - so it stays readable on a black-and-white printer. What happened: it prints as plain text. The four status labels on the printed page were each measured: every one is black text on a white background, with no colour fill behind it. On screen the same labels are green pills. The printed page as a whole is also black on white throughout, so nothing depends on colour to be understood.

Also measured while checking this: the printed text is 10 point, which is the smallest size the requirements allow, so it is within the limit but only just.
